sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-4B Math Fine-Tuned (Nemotron-SFT-Math-v3) This model is a fine-tuned version of Qwen3.5-4B, explicitly optimized for complex mathematical reasoning and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) problem solving. It was fine-tuned using the Nemotron-Math-v3 dataset with Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT/LoRA).
